scope: Deduplicated 14x14 coordinate coverage from three pinned independent audit reports; production directories are read-only

rootInstructions.modelPolicy: Free/existing GPT Image 2.5 preferred; existing builtin GPT Image 2.0 fallback allowed. This aggregate performs no generation and makes no project-wide stoppage claim.

coverageDefinition.complete_native_candidate: Coordinate has a complete 4096 native-pixel candidate supported by source audit; includes unadopted/private candidates, independent of internal QA
coverageDefinition.partial_native: At least one native core position is saved/selected in the source snapshot, fewer than a complete coordinate; raw may include retained rejected variants
coverageDefinition.no_native_coverage_reported: Source report has no selected/usable native coverage for this coordinate; does not assert absence of all historical rejected PNG files
coverageDefinition.internalPassed: Current candidate has source-pinned independent/root internal evidence; does not certify external boundaries
coverageDefinition.selectedNativeCoreCount: Unique 4x4 base core slots selected per report, excluding additional native repair contributions; null when selection is not established
coverageDefinition.rawAvailableNativeCoreCount: Only provided where source report gives raw available core-slot counts; null for SE because that report inventories selection, not all historical raw variants

ownership.northeast: r01..r07 c08..c14, excluding six exclusive acceleration coordinates
